Run coding agents without babysitting them. Keep jobs focused, bounded, checked and accountable from start to finish. Finally run your agents swarms overnight and get your time back.

Open source AI infrastructure layer. Eight agents run on every request: security, caching, memory, hallucination detection, tamper-proof audit trail. One line of code. Your data never leaves your server.

CQRS and Event Sourcing for .NET — with tamper-evident streams and tenant-aware encryption built in, and an Orleans execution model to scale out. Integrated mediator, outbox, sagas, projections, and identity across 27 lockstep-versioned NuGet packages. MIT-licensed.
